description: Query cross-network engagement analytics (`account_overview`, `post_metrics`, `audience_growth`), compute AI-recommended optimal posting windows (`best_times`), or execute live real-time social listening (`social_listen`) across Bluesky, Hacker News, Dev.to, Reddit, and X. Use `social_listen` to discover live community threads, competitor mentions, and high-intent buyer questions matching any keyword query. Returns aggregated engagement metrics, X Smart Link cost savings, optimal CET/UTC posting slots, or live upstream social signals with direct thread URLs and author handles.

accountId.description: Connected account id (`acc_...`). For Instagram/Facebook/Threads, returns live account insights plus recent posts with per-post insights.

action.description: Analytics or listening mode: 'account_overview' for cross-network KPIs, 'post_metrics' or 'post_detail' for individual post performance (including live YouTube viewCount, likeCount, commentCount, and publishedAt age in hours), 'audience_growth' for follower velocity, 'best_times' for highest-lift publishing windows, or 'social_listen' for live keyword/intent discovery.

externalPostId.description: Optional native platform video/post ID (e.g. YouTube `videoId`) to fetch live `viewCount`, `likeCount`, `commentCount`, and `publishedAt` age in hours.

periodDays.description: Lookback window in days (e.g. 7, 30, 90) for aggregating impressions, engagements, and follower growth.

platform.description: Optional social network filter to scope metrics or listening to a single platform.

postId.description: Optional post identifier (`post_...`) when inspecting granular metrics via `action: 'post_metrics'` or `'post_detail'`.

postLimit.description: Max recent posts (1-25) with per-post insights for Instagram/Facebook/Threads overviews.

profileId.description: Brand profile identifier (`prof_...`) to aggregate analytics for.

query.description: Search keyword, brand name, competitor handle, or buyer-intent phrase when running live `action: 'social_listen'` (e.g. 'MCP server social media API' or 'n8n AI agent workflow').

name: analytics_query
title: Cross-Network Analytics & Live Social Listening
